description:
Optional Phase-5 extension that adds a HaveIBeenPwned-style online
    compromised-password checker on top of the V00.71 SPI from
    jCustos-core. The checker uses the k-anonymity range API: only
    the first five hex chars of the candidate's SHA-1 digest leave the
    process, never the plaintext password (CWE-359). The implementation
    relies on JDK HttpClient only — no additional runtime dependencies.
    Strictly opt-in; applications that do not depend on this module
    perform no online lookups.
